# Relationship Predicate Registry

Contract version: `1.0.0`

Canonical relationship-predicate registry for the Relational Intelligence Spine (Social360 + Relationship Fidelity program, blueprint §§21-26). Declares relationship predicate semantics as governed data rather than hard-coded service logic: family, directionality, reciprocity, transitivity/path behavior, direct-vs-derived provenance, sensitive-inference policy, and honest graph-registration state. Entries feed RelationshipAssertion validation, relationship promotion (M6), motif output predicates (M6), and fidelity-aware path composition (M8). Generated TS, Python, and Markdown twins derive from this file via scripts/generate_platform_contracts.py. The graphEdgeType field references canonical EdgeType values only where such an edge is registered in shared/graph; predicates whose canonical graph edge awaits Milestone M6 registration carry graphRegistrationState=PENDING_M6_REGISTRATION.
